Obi-Wan Kenobi'' |author=[[Ryder Windham]]''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' |cover artist=[[Hugh Fleming]] |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Scholastic]] |early release= |release date=[[September]] [[2008]] |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Hardcover (slipcase) |pages=214 |isbn=0545085594 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=*[[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] {{Flash}} *[[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] {{Flash}} *[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] {{Flash}} *[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] {{Flash}} *[[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] {{Flash}} *[[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]] {{Flash}} *[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] {{Flash}} *[[3 ABY/Legends|3.5]]–[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] *[[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi''''' is a young-adult novel written by [[Ryder Windham]]. The book was originally scheduled for release in [[October]] [[2008]], one year after the release of its predecessor, ''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''. It retells the story of the first six ''[[Star Wars]]'' films from the point of view of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. In addition, it contains a prologue and several interludes from [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] perspective, between the times of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|'' The Empire Strikes Back'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|'' Return of the Jedi'']]. While the majority of the book recaps previously told stories, it does introduce some new elements into ''Star Wars'' [[canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.
